risk_summary: The disclosure is largely precise and well quantified, documenting strong revenue, profitability, liquidity, capital expenditure, and dividend performance. Key risks include automotive-sector and customer concentration, raw-material and labor cost volatility, inflation, competitive pressures, and potentially weaker 2013 equipment-segment demand. The tone is cautiously optimistic but relies on standard forward-looking disclaimers and uncertain macroeconomic assumptions.
